subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver` in `openclaw.json`, an in-TUI setting, or a changed CLI default with explicit opt-out?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally frame delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
options.body: Add the default through the chosen canonical surface with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI flag precedence.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery as an intentional per-session flag and document or close the ergonomics request after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Change the default instead
options.body: Make delivery on by default with `--no-deliver` opt-out only if maintainers accept the compatibility and message-delivery behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
recommendation.body: Add the default through the chosen canonical surface with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI flag precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The TUI surface traces back to steipete's commits, and this is primarily a TUI/default product decision.
